concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-006 (explicit flagging of any dataset‑variable gaps where a required descriptor is missing) is not addressed by any task. No task logs or reports missing descriptor columns beyond oxidation‑state handling.
Success Criterion SC-004 (pipeline must complete ≤ 30 minutes per run on a CPU‑only runner) has no associated task that measures, enforces, or validates this runtime bound.

Constitution principle III requires checksums for all raw and derived files, yet no task records or updates SHA‑256 checksums after data download, featurisation, validation, augmentation, or model artefact creation.
